create table account_link_tokens (
        id bigint generated by default as identity,
        created_at timestamp(6),

create table audit_logs (
        id bigint generated by default as identity,
        action varchar(255) check (action in ('USER_REGISTER','LOGIN_ATTEMPT','MFA_VERIFY','PASSWORD_RESET_REQUEST','PASSWORD_RESET','CHANGE_PASSWORD','LOGOUT','OAUTH_LOGIN','OAUTH_LINK','PROFILE_UPDATE','SELF_DELETE','DEVICE_TRUST_ADD','DEVICE_REMOVE','DEVICE_REMOVE_OTHERS','ADMIN_DELETE_USER','ADMIN_BLOCK_USER','ADMIN_UNBLOCK_USER','REFRESH_TOKEN_ROTATION','REFRESH_TOKEN_REUSE')),

        description varchar(500),
        ip varchar(255),
        target_user_id bigint,
        user_agent varchar(255),
        primary key (id)
    )

create table login_activity (
        id bigint generated by default as identity,
        created_at timestamp(6),
        email varchar(255),
        ip_address varchar(255),
        message varchar(255),
        status varchar(255),
        user_agent varchar(255),
        user_id bigint,
        primary key (id)
    )

create table mfa_tokens (
        id bigint generated by default as identity,
        expires_at timestamp(6) not null,
        otp varchar(255) not null,
        risk_based boolean not null,
        used boolean not null,
        user_id bigint not null,
        primary key (id)
    )

        id bigint generated by default as identity,
        active boolean,
        device_name varchar(255),
        device_signature varchar(255) not null,
        trusted_at timestamp(6),
        user_id bigint,
        primary key (id)
    )

create table user_ip_log (
        id bigint generated by default as identity,
        city varchar(100),
        country_code varchar(10),
        device_name varchar(100),
        device_signature varchar(255),

        ip_address varchar(100) not null,

        user_id bigint,

    )

create table user_oauth_providers (
        id bigint generated by default as identity,
        active boolean not null,
        linked_at timestamp(6),
        provider_id varchar(255) not null,
        provider_type varchar(255) not null check (provider_type in ('GOOGLE','GITHUB','FACEBOOK','TWITTER','MICROSOFT','APPLE','EMAIL')),
        user_id bigint not null,
        primary key (id)
    )

create table user_refresh_tokens (
        id bigint generated by default as identity,
        created_at timestamp(6),

        expires_at timestamp(6),
        invalidated boolean not null,
        token varchar(255) not null,
        used boolean not null,
        user_id bigint,
        primary key (id)
    )

create table user_roles (
        user_id bigint not null,
        role varchar(255)
    )

create table users (
        id bigint generated by default as identity,
        active boolean not null,
        created_at timestamp(6),
        email varchar(255) not null,
        email_verified boolean not null,
        full_name varchar(255) not null,
        mfa_enabled boolean not null,
        password varchar(255),
        token_version integer not null,
        updated_at timestamp(6),
        primary key (id)
    )

create table verification_tokens (
        id bigint generated by default as identity,

        type varchar(255) not null,
        used_at timestamp(6),
